editorial:
Ever wondered what to do when the world ends? Imagine a weird millionaire with a giant moustache telling you exactly how to survive the Mayan apocalypse. That is exactly what you get here. The vibe is totally offbeat and silly, as John Hodgman takes you through his personal plan for the end of times. He treats the apocalypse like a shopping trip, listing the most random items you will need to stay alive. It feels less like a traditional movie and more like a hilarious, high-energy presentation from a guy who has spent way too much time thinking about doomsday.

What really works is Hodgman's timing and his strange obsession with things like beef jerky and mayonnaise. The pacing stays quick, so you never get bored by the talking. While it might be too weird for some, it is a goldmine for anyone who loves deadpan humor. If you want to experience this in the best quality, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see every detail of that legendary moustache. You could also rent it on Apple TV for a quick laugh with friends. It is a short, punchy ride that does not take itself seriously at all.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with Hodgman finishing his ridiculous list of survival tips. Instead of a giant explosion or a scary monster ending, the whole thing is a comedic build-up. He basically convinces you that as long as you have his specific, weird items and his guidance, you can handle the chaos. It ends on a funny note, leaving you laughing at the absurdity of his plan rather than fearing the actual end of the world.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dry humor and strange characters.
